sources.label: Official Superdry men's size guide (product-page Size Guide: chest, waist, low hip/seat, cm; international sizing)
Product page the guide was opened from

audit: Stored URL /info/size-guide is no longer the guide; chart read from the product-page Size Guide (cdn.superdry.com/size_guides/mens_en_280.html, linked from superdry.com/mens/t-shirts/essential-serif-logo-embroidered-t-shirt-279276.html). Old single values were low and had no hips: M chest 94 -> 96-101, waist 79 -> 80-85; L chest 100 -> 101-106; XXL chest 113 -> 111-116. XXS, 3XL and 4XL added; hips (low hip/seat) added. EU sizes kept as published (XS = EU 44, matching stored). UK column is letter sizes only, and the US/CA column gives chest inches, so uk/us are not stored.
